notes:
- Shorts car mode (settings): each Short plays once, then the next starts by itself, also with the screen off
- Next and previous on the car, a headset or the lock screen now change Shorts (and work in Curious)
- Shorts show on the lock screen and the car display with their title
- Security: MoreTube now only opens YouTube links, only YouTube pages can talk to the app, a name in a room can no longer run as code, relays are checked by name, fake join requests are refused
- Privacy: sponsor lookups no longer reveal what you watch, and your sign-in is kept out of backups
